runtime_rules_grounded_in_source: AuthoredWorldDirector.BuildScatter: count = round(pi r^2 density), one RandomNumberGenerator with the authored seed, plants skipped when road.Distance < road.HalfWidth + roadClearance or inside an exclude circle, models[rng.RandiRange(0, models.Length - 1)]

verified.probe: PASS 154/154. The real campaign has 8 scatter entities: all pass the same rules, every one declares a seed, each carries its 45 exclusion circles, and the projected plant count is 45, which matches round(pi r^2 density) exactly. Synthetic cases prove each refusal: no species (the runtime would call RandiRange(0, -1)), no seed (Redo would not reproduce the layout), an oversized brush (blocked with the budget numbers before Apply), an inverted size range, malformed exclusions and an unknown stroke mode. Both runtime link checks are clean on the real sources.
